claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at 5:07 p.m. PDT.
The Artemis II mission had a four-astronaut crew.
The Artemis II mission lasted 10 days.
The Artemis II mission was around the moon.
The Artemis II crew concluded their mission safely.
Recovery teams from the USS John P. Murtha were standing by.
The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission was the first human voyage to the moon in over 50 years.
